author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam welcomes back to the cave Star Wars puppet builder and cosplayer Darren Moser (aka  @drscifi ), who brings a new droid he designed called 2L-BX (aka Tool Box!). Not only is 2L-BX a fully remote-controlled droid that would fit right into a Star Wars film, he's also a fully-functional toolbox equipped with deployable power tools! We take a look inside this delightful droid creation to see just how he works. 

Find Darren's other builds and projects: http://www.drscifi.com/ https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEmlBCbLwocSEWNi3oZ6WGw and https://www.instagram.com/drscifi/

Shot and edited by Joey Fameli
Music by Jinglepunks
